title: vb-benchmark-cleanup: Remove RED-PHASE STUB marker; convert aggregate_resource_budget.rs to real Criterion bench
description: Chore S-19. Master §39 Mandatory Benchmarks and §40 CI Gate require a real bench-build task with Criterion benchmarks that produce actionable numbers, not compileable scaffolds. Today vb_benchmark is declared 'RED PHASE STUB' by its own module doc; tests/benchmark_tests.rs has 12 `// STUB: This test will FAIL` markers. vb_core/benches/aggregate_resource_budget.rs is a soft no-op scaffold (uses black_box(source).contains(...) as the 'benchmark'). The 'every speed claim requires real evidence' rule (master §0, §39) is violated by these stubs. This bead: (1) in vb_benchmark/src/lib.rs, remove the 'RED PHASE NOTICE' comment; either implement the real benchmark infrastructure or delete the crate; (2) in vb_core/benches/aggregate_resource_budget.rs, replace the black_box(source).contains(...) with a real Criterion benchmark; (3) add the bench to .moon.yml bench-build task list.

THE SYSTEM SHALL remove the 'RED PHASE STUB' marker from vb_benchmark/src/lib.rs

THE SYSTEM SHALL build all benches including vb_benchmark and vb_core/benches/aggregate_resource_budget.rs
